title: The Country Inside a Country
art_style: cute 2D vector sticker illustration, minimalist flat design, chibi proportions, flat colors with no gradients, muted earthy palette, clean dark outline, full body, centered, isolated on a solid plain white background, no text

scenes.narration: This whole country is completely surrounded by another country. And all of it sits above a thousand meters.
This is Lesotho, an island of mountains in the middle of South Africa.
Only three countries on Earth are fully inside another one: San Marino, Vatican City and Lesotho.
And Lesotho is by far the biggest of them, with over two million people.
Even its lowest point is one thousand four hundred meters high. No other country has a lowest point that high.
That's why it's called the Kingdom in the Sky.
So why didn't South Africa swallow it? In the 1860s, King Moshoeshoe asked Britain for protection against Boer settlers.
scenes.tts: So why didn't South Africa swallow it? In the eighteen-sixties, King Moshoeshoe asked Britain for protection against Boer settlers.

scenes.narration: Britain ran it separately as Basutoland. So when South Africa formed, Lesotho stayed out, and became independent in 1966.
scenes.tts: Britain ran it separately as Basutoland. So when South Africa formed, Lesotho stayed out, and became independent in nineteen sixty-six.

scenes.narration: Up here, people still ride ponies through the mountains, wrapped in colorful wool blankets.

scenes.narration: And yes, Lesotho has a ski resort. In Africa.

scenes.narration: Its rivers even supply water to South Africa's biggest city.
Would you live in the Kingdom in the Sky? Yes or no?
